body:
S1 is up as #2699, branch bug-2169-s1. It contains the sketch doc and the implementation; the clone path sits behind [contained] seat_tree = "clone", and the default is unchanged.
- The seat_clone accessor creates the clone (with base pin and marker), refuses loudly with no worktree fallback, and resolves main from files only (marker + alternates + clone lease).
- SessionLease gets a serde-default tree_kind. contained_seat is threaded through agent new, queue work and session start.
- session end refuses clone leases until S3.
- Condition 1: a PATH-isolated git-shim test shows no git runs in a clone outside the accessor, with a negative control.
- check-ci-fast (30 gates) and check-ci-compile pass. 13 new tests.
Watch for: the (BUG-2169) trailer may auto-complete the spec on merge while S2-S4 remain. Also, agent_launch tests fail if they inherit AIDA_CONTAINED from the shell; this predates S1.
subject: PR READY: #2699 BUG-2169 S1 (7d68fcc022)
